prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1075; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with a side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and is now seeking compensation for medical care, lost income, and the pain and disruption that followed. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide, within thirty days, a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including all liability limits, along with a statement identifying any other coverage that may apply to this loss.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic communications concerning the accident. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such records until this matter is fully resolved.
